subject: Request: short trial extension & onboarding credits — SSO integration blocker
messages:
From: Eva Thompson <eva.thompson@cloudrentals.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: SSO integration blocker — request for short extension & onboarding credits

Hi Olga,

Quick note from the CloudRentals infra team — we hit an unexpected blocker integrating our SSO provider with Redwood’s private deployment. Our engineering lead needs another sprint to complete the OIDC mapping and test logins. Because of the delay we won’t be able to complete the trial POC by the original expiry (Jan 21).

Can you help with: 1) a short trial extension (2–3 weeks) and 2) a small onboarding credit pool we can use during validation? The extra credits will let our QA run a full pass once SSO is in place without incurring unexpected costs.

We’re committed to finishing the technical work quickly — estimated by the end of next week — but need runway. Happy to jump on a 30-min call with your CS if that helps.

Thanks,
Eva Thompson
Head of Platform, CloudRentals Inc.
+1 415-555-0134

---

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Eva Thompson <eva.thompson@cloudrentals.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SSO integration blocker — request for short extension & onboarding credits

Hi Eva — thanks for the heads up and for outlining the timeline.

We can absolutely help. Proposed approach:
- Extend the trial by 21 days from the current expiry (new expiry: Feb 11).
- Provide a temporary onboarding credit pool of $4,000 to cover validation runs.
- Condition: we’d like to schedule a joint QA / onboarding sync next week so Monica can walk your team through the KV cache and rate-limit settings that commonly affect SSO-bound POCs.

I’m looping in Monica (CS) and Rafael (sales director) to confirm approvals and next steps. If Rafael wants to adjust the credit amount, he’ll chime in.

If that works, I’ll send a short confirmation PDF to sign (trial-extension-form.pdf) so our operations team can apply it immediately.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 646-555-0191

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Eva Thompson <eva.thompson@cloudrentals.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 13:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SSO integration blocker — request for short extension & onboarding credits

Hi Eva — happy to run the onboarding sync.

Suggested agenda for the 30-min call:
- Quick architecture check (SSO flow, redirect URIs) — 8 mins
- Typical KV cache and session TTL implications for SSO users — 6 mins
- Test plan for auth-related failure modes (2–3 scenarios) — 8 mins
- How to consume the temporary credit pool and throttling guardrails — 6 mins

Available windows: Mon 19th 10:00–11:30 ET, Tue 20th 14:00–16:00 ET. Which works for your engineering lead?

I’ll also make sure we prepare a short checklist so your QA team can run the validation immediately after SSO is flipped.

-Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Eva Thompson <eva.thompson@cloudrentals.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Jan 2026 11:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SSO integration blocker — request for short extension & onboarding credits

Thanks team — I approve a 21-day extension and $3,500 in onboarding credits for CloudRentals. Please note the deviation from Olga’s ask (I reduced the credit slightly to align to the forecasted ARR).

Olga — can you: 1) update the deal record (CR-2026-031) in HubSpot with the extension and credit line, 2) route the trial-extension-form.pdf to ops for application, and 3) confirm the signed doc back to Eva?

If Commerce needs a different funding code, loop me in.

-Rafael
Sales Director, Redwood Inference

Hi Eva — confirmed. Thank you for working through this with us.

Summary and next steps (confirming Rafael’s approval):
- Trial extended 21 days; new expiry: 2026-02-11
- Onboarding credit applied: $3,500 (consumable against token usage and bandwidth during the POC)
- Attached: trial-extension-form.pdf (please sign and return — stubbed attachment)
- Onboarding sync: Mon 19 Jan 10:30 ET with your engineering lead and our CS (Monica). Monica will send calendar invite.

Attachments: trial-extension-form.pdf (application form)

If you can sign and return the PDF I’ll route to Ops and confirm once the credit has posted.

Thanks — talk soon.
